initialExam.title: Canara Bank PO 2026
initialExam.description: Canara Bank Probationary Officer recruitment for management trainee positions. One of the largest public sector banks in India with branches across the country.
initialExam.eligibility: Graduate from a recognized university with 60% marks
initialExam.qualifications: Graduation in any discipline with minimum 60%
initialExam.syllabus: Reasoning, Quantitative Aptitude, English Language, General Awareness, Computer Aptitude.
initialExam.examPattern: Prelims: 100 questions, 100 marks, 1 hour. Mains: 200 marks, 2.5 hours + Descriptive: 25 marks, 30 min.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Prelims → Mains → Group Discussion → Interview → Final Selection
initialExam.jobRole: Probationary Officer in Canara Bank branches
initialExam.careerGrowth: PO → Officer → Manager → Senior Manager → Chief Manager → AGM → DGM → GM.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit canarabank.com 2. Go to Careers 3. Register 4. Fill form 5. Pay fee 6. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, LFC, NPS, Vehicle Loan, Housing Loan, Leased accommodation
